info.title: Hexascore API
info.summary: Community scores for games, movies, TV series and books.
info.description:
Read-only REST API over the Hexascore catalog: every item carries a 0–100 community score and six per-category averages.

- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer hx_live_…` — create a key at `/profile/api`.
- **Format**: JSON, `snake_case` fields, ISO 8601 dates. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
- **Pagination**: cursor based — pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.
- **Plans**: Free = 100 requests in total, 10 items per page, 1 req/s. Pro and Business have monthly quotas, 100 items per page and prepaid credits.

Guides: https://hexascore.com/docs

get.description: Pages through games with filters. Categories for this type: `gameplay`, `fun`, `sound`, `technical`, `visual`, `storytelling` — filter with `min_<category>`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is `null`.

parameters.description: Exact genre, as returned by the genres endpoint.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field; prefix with `-` for descending. Unscored/undated items always come last.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100. Free plan: up to 10.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and synopses (`en`, `pt-BR`, `es`). Falls back to English.

type.description: Kind of item. List endpoints use the plural path (`/games`, `/movies`, `/series`, `/books`).

title.description: Title in the requested locale, English when missing.

score.description: Community score 0–100 (mean of the six categories). `null` until the item has 5 ratings.

categories.description: Average per category, 0–100, `null` under 5 ratings. Keys by type — `game`: `gameplay`, `fun`, `sound`, `technical`, `visual`, `storytelling`; `movie`: `screenplay`, `acting`, `direction`, `cinematography`, `soundtrack`, `entertainment`; `series`: `screenplay`, `acting`, `characters`, `pacing`, `production`, `entertainment`; `book`: `plot`, `characters`, `writing`, `pacing`, `originality`, `impact`.

platforms.description: Platforms (games only; empty for other types).

url.description: Public page of the item on the website, in the requested locale.
